title: Kristal Van Slyck v. City of Moose Jaw WM2026-0716
municipalities: City of Moose Jaw, Board of Revision
description: The Kristal Van Slyck appeal of the 2026 assessment for 353 High Street West was dismissed because the Board of Revision found that no material errors in the assessment were proven. The Board confirmed the property's assessed value at $949,100 and upheld all aspects of the assessment.
